explanation:
Registers limit to 21 warps; whole blocks of 8 warps means 2 blocks (16 warps). Warp slots would allow 8 blocks and block
slots 32, so registers decide: 16 / 64 = 25%. Capping registers at 64 per thread (`__launch_bounds__` or
`-maxrregcount`) would allow 4 blocks (50%), at the risk of spilling to slow local memory. Check it in the occupancy
widget above.
